baseline.name: Construct separate odd/even-position output
baseline.approach: Copy odd-position nodes then even-position nodes into a new list.

why: Existing nodes supply both chains, avoiding new node allocations and copied payloads.
quantitative_comparison: The archive allocates zero replacement nodes versus n new nodes in the copy baseline. Both visit a linear number of nodes; no measured runtime reduction is available.
tradeoffs: Changes original links and cannot preserve the original list topology for other readers. Grouping is by position rather than value parity.
evidence_basis: Static allocation/ownership comparison against a copy-preserving baseline; no benchmark.
